mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 months reduces discount rates, increasing the present value of expected equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% triggers a risk-off reaction, compressing discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment benefits (PAYEMS) signals weak labor demand, reducing investor confidence and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns in slack periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in unemployment benefits (PAYEMS) below 150,000 triggers a risk-on reaction, boosting investor confidence and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 110 indicates weakening supply-side momentum, compressing discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in soft landing periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in home sales (HOUST) above 1.2 million units signals strong demand, boosting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in home sales (HOUST) below 1 million units triggers a risk-off reaction, compressing discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in contraction periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the CPIAUCSL inflation index below 3% for 3 months reduces discount rates, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in low inflation periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
